reports.md:
**How the capture went through the product**

Starting from the page after sign-in, it opened menu items, tabs and links. 30 screenshots taken.

It opened every screen it found.

**Not clicked**

- **Buttons and dialogs:** not opened. Choose "Buttons and dialogs" to capture them.
- **Would change data, so not pressed:** Launch sample course, Delete all drafts, Save settings, Reset password, Delete user, Send message. Choose "Also press buttons that change data" to include them.
- **Never pressed:** Sign out, Make a payment, Pay invoice, Log out, Log in as this user. Signing out, paying and acting as another user are never done.
- **On another site, so not followed:** Vendor docs, Connect partner portal
- **Sorting, paging, carousel and calendar controls, not clicked (they show the same screen):** 16
- **The same button on each item of a list, opened for the first item only:** Actions (4 more)
- **Downloads, not opened:** 1

**Opened, but not kept**

- **Showed the site's error message, so not kept, and nothing on it was opened:** Plans > 2023 Succession Plan
- **The same as a screen already captured, so not kept again:** 1

**Check these screenshots**

- Plans — The page looked empty when it was captured. Check this image.
- Admin > Settings — The page looked empty when it was captured. Check this image.
- Admin > Integrations — The page looked empty when it was captured. Check this image.
- Lab > Spin — The page was still loading after 12 seconds when it was captured. Check this image.
- Catalog > Course 1 — The page looked empty when it was captured. Check this image.
- Catalog > Course 1 details — The page looked empty when it was captured. Check this image.
- Users > Inactive users — The page looked empty when it was captured. Check this image.
- Reports > Report 1 — The page looked empty when it was captured. Check this image.
- Audit log — The page looked empty when it was captured. Check this image.

**Other requests the pages made**

The pages also sent 4 requests that were not plain reads (searches, tracking, loading data), as they do for anyone using them. These went through; nothing in their address or content said they change data:

- POST /api/track
